items.rationale: Single-pass unquote allowed double-encoded traversal payloads (e.g. %252e%252e%252f) to bypass the '..' segment check. Fixed by iteratively decoding until stable and splitting on '/' before checking for '..' segments. Additionally blocked drive-letter absolute paths.

AppSec confirmed exploit reproduces through encoded separators and symlink escapes. Fix addresses encoded separators by iterative unquote and segment-based '..' detection. Symlink escapes are caught by the existing resolve + prefix check.
JWT key rotation is out of scope for this hotfix per AppSec review. Will be addressed in a follow-up change.
Rotate JWT material later; do not fold into this hotfix.
